course.title: Power System I
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A balanced induction motor takes 5.4 kW at 0.6 p.f. from a line voltage of 200 (15) volts. It is in parallel with a pure resistive balanced wye load taking 5 kW. Determine the condenser size to get the overall p.f. 0.95 lagging. Also determine the line current of the combination.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
